# SynapseKit

> Async-native Python framework for building LLM-powered applications: RAG pipelines, ReAct agents, graph workflows, and agent federation. 2 hard dependencies. Apache 2.0.

## Overview

SynapseKit is an open-source Python library for engineers who want to ship LLM-powered features without inheriting a large dependency tree or opaque abstractions. It is a lightweight alternative to LangChain and LlamaIndex.

- Version: 1.9.1
- License: Apache 2.0
- Language: Python 3.9+
- Hard dependencies: 2 (numpy, rank-bm25)
- GitHub: https://github.com/SynapseKit/SynapseKit
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/synapsekit/
- Docs: https://synapsekit.github.io/synapsekit-docs/
- Discord: https://discord.gg/PSuAXHRywJ

## Key Capabilities

- **33 LLM providers** — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, Ollama, LM Studio, xAI Grok, Groq, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Together AI, Replicate, HuggingFace, GPT4All, vLLM, and more
- **53 document loaders** — PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, CSV, JSON, JSONL, Parquet, S3, Azure Blob, GCS, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, BigQuery, YouTube, Sitemap, Airtable, HubSpot, Salesforce, Obsidian, OneDrive, Dropbox, and more
- **11 vector stores** — Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector, Redis, MongoDB Atlas, SQLiteVec, FAISS, in-memory
- **47+ built-in tools** — web search, code execution, file I/O, calculator, weather, Wikipedia, SQL, REST APIs, browser automation (Playwright), and more
- **RAG pipelines** — hybrid BM25+vector search, reranking, multimodal (audio/video/image), configurable chunking
- **ReAct agents** — tool use with Reason+Act loop, custom tools as plain Python functions
- **Graph workflows** — directed graphs with branching, loops, conditional routing, parallel execution, recursive subgraphs
- **AgentFederation** — distributed multi-agent routing via in-memory or Redis registry
- **Async-native** — every component supports async/await throughout
- **Evaluation** — EvalDataset, EvalRecord, PromptOptimizer, EvalCI GitHub Action

## Architecture

SynapseKit is structured as a collection of composable modules:

- `synapsekit.llms` — LLM provider adapters (all implement a common async interface)
- `synapsekit.rag` — Document loaders, chunkers, embedders, vector stores, retrievers
- `synapsekit.agents` — ReAct agent runtime, tool registry, AgentMemory
- `synapsekit.graph` — Graph workflow engine with node/edge primitives
- `synapsekit.federation` — AgentFederation, AgentRegistry (in-memory + Redis)
- `synapsekit.eval` — EvalDataset, EvalRecord, PromptOptimizer, ContinuousTrainer
- `synapsekit.tools` — 47+ built-in tool implementations
- `synapsekit.output` — StructuredOutput with Pydantic validation and retries
- `synapsekit.memory` — AgentMemory with SQLite/Redis/Postgres backends
- `synapsekit.context` — SmartContextManager with Anthropic prompt caching

## Installation

```
pip install synapsekit
```

Optional extras:
- `pip install synapsekit[chroma]` — Chroma vector store
- `pip install synapsekit[pinecone]` — Pinecone vector store
- `pip install synapsekit[qdrant]` — Qdrant vector store
- `pip install synapsekit[browser]` — Playwright browser tool
- `pip install synapsekit[audio]` — Whisper audio loader

Full installation guide: https://synapsekit.github.io/synapsekit-docs/getting-started/installation

## Comparison

| Feature | SynapseKit | LangChain | LlamaIndex |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hard dependencies | 2 | 60+ | 40+ |
| Async-native | Yes | Partial | Partial |
| LLM providers | 33 | 30+ | 20+ |
| Document loaders | 53 | 100+ | 50+ |
| Vector stores | 11 | 15+ | 15+ |
| Graph workflows | Yes | LangGraph (separate) | Yes |
| Agent federation | Yes | No | No |
| Built-in eval | Yes | LangSmith (paid) | Yes |
| EvalCI GitHub Action | Yes | No | No |
| License | Apache 2.0 | MIT | MIT |
| Telemetry | None | Optional | Optional |
